notes: The declared versions pin the workflow an evaluation run describes. If the live detector or workflow version differs, the evaluator REFUSES rather than silently reporting metrics under a version the config does not describe. Creating a new run under a new version is explicit (--new-run) and updates this file in a reviewed commit.

pass_fail_thresholds is null on purpose. No gate exists for real-filing metrics and none may be introduced until an initial human-verified baseline exists and has been explicitly approved. The synthetic comparison-regression suite remains the merge-blocking deterministic gate.
Only pairs whose annotation file is human_verified enter gold numerators and denominators. Machine-proposed labels are never mixed in.
